The '''Phraetiss system ''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the planet [[Phraetiss]].

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon content===
The system was patrolled by [[Phraetiss system patrol cruiser]]s which were designed to intercept [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and outlaws.<ref name="Polyhedron 100">{{PolyhedronCite|100|The Tyaonon Ranger: A Fast Ship for Star Wars Campaigns}}</ref>
